name: Plug Spinner
description: After picking a lock in the wrong rotational direction, a plug spinner rapidly spins the cylinder back past the set position to the opposite direction without dropping the set pins. This avoids the need to re-pick the lock when tension was applied in the wrong direction — a common occurrence when the correct rotation is unknown before picking. A plug spinner is a small but meaningful time-saver on harder cylinders where re-picking costs significant effort.

blue.det: Indicates lock picking has already occurred; audible spinning if detected.
blue.cm: High-security cylinders reduce picking success that would necessitate plug spinner; door alarms; access log monitoring.
